page.overview:
What is Stonefoots?

The Stonefoots were one of the houses of the Seven Fathers of the Dwarves that dwelt in the mountains of the east. They were originally paired with the Blacklocks.

It is possible that the Stonefoots were among the "Houses of other Fathers" who sent troops to help Durin's folk in the War of the Dwarves and Orcs.
